chart.description: 1 Hour Summary of Resources by Connections and Endpoints
chart.name: Most Connected Hubs
chart.programText:
A = data('ConnectionCount', filter=filter('aggregation_type', 'maximum') and filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.SignalRService/SignalR') and filter('azure_region', '*') and filter('azure_subscription_display_name', '*') and filter('azure_resource_name', '*'), rollup='max').sum(by=['azure_region', 'azure_subscription_display_name', 'azure_resource_name']).max(over='1h').publish(label='A')
B = data('ConnectionCount', filter=filter('aggregation_type', 'maximum') and filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.SignalRService/SignalR') and filter('azure_region', '*') and filter('azure_subscription_display_name', '*') and filter('azure_resource_name', '*')).sum(by=['endpoint', 'azure_region', 'azure_subscription_display_name', 'azure_resource_name']).count(by=['azure_region', 'azure_subscription_display_name', 'azure_resource_name']).max(over='1h').publish(label='B')
